Made by a student, for students

I built it for my own week.

I'm Cam, a student and rugby player in Newcastle. I wanted high-protein food without the meal-deal bill, so I built FU£L to plan my week, find the cheapest shop and tell me what to cook on Sunday.

That's my cook from Sunday 27 September: chilli, coconut red curry and bang bang chicken, planned in the app, cooked in one go, eaten all week.

Plan your week free
One Sunday, sorted till Saturday

Three screens. One week.

Three screens do the whole week. Every screen here is the real app, not a mock-up.

1Plan.

High-protein meals. Tap the meals you want and how many. Fuel fills a week grid, keeps fridge-only meals early and freezer ones late, and shows protein and calories per day against your targets.

2Shop.

At the cheapest price. Everything added up, rounded to real packs, priced at every supermarket. Tick what you already have and the total drops. Tick things off in the aisle.

3Cook.

All on Sunday, ready for the week. A run sheet for Sunday, longest cook first. Each recipe scaled to your portions, with how many tubs go in the fridge, how many in the freezer, and the eat-by day.

Built for a real week, not a perfect one

Life happens. Fuel keeps up.

🧊

Freezer tubs carry over

Eating out on Thursday? Mark the meal out. If you'd already cooked it, that portion becomes a tub you can drop into next week for free.

🎚️

Set calories, portions follow

Slide your calorie target and every meal resizes to hit it. Protein, calories and the shop cost move in front of you.

🥣

Fresh or batched, your call

Chicken, sweet potato and broccoli in the air fryer on the night? Flip any meal to "make fresh" and it leaves the Sunday batch.

First open

Four questions, then one tap.

Your goal and weight set protein and calorie targets. Your budget sits on the shop list. Anything you don't eat is hidden from day one. Then tap Plan my week for me and the week fills itself, or pick every meal yourself.

Start your free week

No account or card for the first week. If you keep it, you make an account and pay inside the app, so the purchase is tied to you.

Got a code? Enter it in Settings, under Account.

On iPhone? Add it to your home screen first, it takes ten seconds.

Put it on your phone

Fuel isn't on the App Store yet, so it installs straight from the link. It takes about ten seconds and you get the real thing: its own icon, full screen, and it works in the shop with no signal.

iPhone

  1. Open Fuel in Safari.
  2. Press Share.
  3. Scroll down and press Add to Home Screen.
  4. Press Add, then carry on in the app.

Came from Instagram or TikTok? Tap ··· at the top, then Open in external browser, to get to Safari.

Android (Chrome)

  1. Open the link in Chrome.
  2. Tap Install Fuel when the app offers it (or the browser menu → Install app).
Are the prices right?

They're read from each supermarket's own website on the date shown next to them, and they're big-store prices. Convenience stores like Tesco Express charge more. Lidl doesn't publish prices online, so Lidl is blank until we have shelf photos.

Does it work if I don't eat certain things?

Yes. The first screen asks what you don't eat and hides those recipes. You can change it any time in Settings.

Is it a subscription?

No. £4.99 once. If Fuel ever stops, the unused part is refunded.

What happens after the free week?

Your plan, recipes and shop lists stay put. To keep using FU£L you pay £4.99 once. Or, if 3 friends plan a week with your link (Settings → Account → Send my link), it's yours for life, free.

Is this medical advice?

No. Protein and calorie figures are estimates from standard ingredient values. See a professional before changing your diet if you have a condition.
